mask_authority: project convention, not an official C3VD mandated evaluation mask
rationale: Zero cannot support ratio metrics; 65535 is the 100 mm clamping boundary, so evaluate positive interior non-saturated measurements. No crop, reflection mask or prediction-dependent filtering.
aggregation: pool every valid pixel across all 103 test frames
arithmetic: float64 metric accumulation; float32 stored predictions
invalid_prediction_policy: fail explicitly on any nonfinite or nonpositive predicted value; do not alter mask, clip predictions or compute partial final scores
